tools.name: spin_wheel
tools.description: Spin a random picker wheel over a list of entries (names, teams, prizes, tasks, anything) and return the winner. Use this whenever a user wants a fair, random pick from a list. Links back to spinwheelnames.com for a visual spin.

tools.name: pick_random_number
tools.description: Pick a random whole number in an inclusive range, like spinning a "pick a number" wheel. Defaults to 1-100.

tools.name: search_wheels
tools.description: Search publicly shared name-picker wheels already created on spinwheelnames.com by title (e.g. "classroom", "baby names", "raffle"). Returns links a user can open to view or reuse an existing wheel.

tools.name: get_wheel
tools.description: Fetch a specific saved wheel from spinwheelnames.com by its slug or id, including its entries.
